description: This file defines the CheckoutModel class for the checkout page of an e-commerce web application, handling basket retrieval, order creation, and user authentication/authorization.

classes.name: CheckoutModel
classes.description: PageModel class for handling the checkout process, including fetching basket data, creating orders, and managing user sessions.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to load the checkout page and initialize the basket model.

methods.name: OnPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to process checkout, update basket quantities, create an order, and handle potential exceptions.

methods.name: SetBasketModelAsync
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a basket view model for the current user based on their sign-in status.

methods.name: GetOrSetBasketCookieAndUserName
methods.description: Ensures a cookie and username are set for anonymous users to associate basket data.
